unit: failed rubric item on a rendered case

categories.label: Missed Renderer Defaults
categories.description: Omitted settings or renderer conventions (defaults, accepted-but-reinterpreted data shapes, silently dropped keys, chart-type name collisions) change the chart.

categories.label: Failed Workaround
categories.description: The DSL lacks the requested chart or composition, and the substitute chart or hand-built workaround does not preserve the requested semantics.

categories.label: Layout Arithmetic Failure
categories.description: Spacing, sizing, margins, or panel geometry are not coordinated, so titles, legends, axes, or panels collide, clip, or overflow.

categories.label: Encoding Mismatch
categories.description: The right data field is used, but placed in a part of the spec that does not drive the requested encoding (color, legend, position).

categories.label: Rendering pipeline (out of scope)
categories.description: Caused by our rendering setup rather than the model or DSL, e.g. an optional chart module or plugin that the harness did not load.

categories.label: Uncoded
categories.description: Failed rubric items that no code in the codebook explains.

codes.code: No facet / small-multiples primitive
codes.axial: A3 Composition primitive missing from grammar
codes.notes: Multiple grammars (apex, chartjs, frappe, highcharts, zingchart) lack a first-class facet / small-multiples primitive; LLMs hand-compose via stacked-y-axis hacks, multi-yAxis positioning, or graphset arrangements that fake panels.

codes.code: Plotly title bare-string form silently dropped
codes.axial: A7a Strict form silently drops alternative shapes

codes.code: LLM adds annotation marks task did not request
codes.axial: A9 Default behavior diverges from task intent

codes.code: Data URL path unresolved by viewer (host pipeline)

codes.code: Legend pulled from dataset, not from data field
codes.axial: A8 Legend / color subsystem pulls from non-semantic source
codes.notes: Grammar derives legend entries from dataset/series list, not color-scale field; forces dummy series for categorical legends.

codes.code: Imperative layout margins clip axis chrome
codes.axial: A12 Chrome / canvas budget under-allocated

codes.code: Apex polarArea cannot accept multi-series rose

codes.code: ZingChart pie needs one series per slice
codes.axial: A7b Binding shape demands grammar-specific pre-knowledge

codes.code: Frappe has no canvas size knob (no width/height/plotArea)

codes.code: Vega imperative mark-model demands explicit composition
codes.axial: A11 Compound or layered marks need explicit alignment hooks
codes.notes: Vega's imperative mark model demands explicit grouping (group + facet), scale type (band scale for heatmap), KDE composition for violin, sort transform for line, lookup of index fields for facet positioning, and z-order management — declarative grammars give all of these for free.

codes.code: Vega-lite nominal sort defaults to alphabetical

codes.code: Highcharts bar vs column naming collision
codes.axial: A6 Type-name collision picks wrong primitive
codes.notes: Highcharts type:bar (rotated) vs type:column (vertical) reverses the common bar/column convention; LLM picks bar expecting hbar but xAxis stays categorical.

codes.code: No rose / Nightingale / polar-bar primitive

codes.code: JSON cannot express formatter or transform functions

codes.code: Area mark does not auto-baseline at zero

codes.code: ECharts has many chart-type-specific binding contracts

codes.notes: Echarts demands per-chart-type binding shapes the LLM doesn't know: encode requires dataset.source; bubble needs per-item symbolSize; tree needs name field; parallel data shape strict; rose multi-series stacks; pie formatter uses {b}; stacked-area needs stack identifier.

codes.code: Frappe color needs top-level array, not per-dataset

codes.code: Plotly subplot/grid coordination fails
